ip.description: Client IP is not scored directly, but is bound into trusted TLS attestation verification; also usable for separate enrichment

method.description: HTTP method; uncommon values create a heuristic signal

headers.description: Current rules inspect only the presence of Accept and Accept-Language names, case-insensitively

body_snippet.description: Optional body metadata; current classify rules do not inspect it. Avoid sensitive content

accept.description: Metadata only; use the headers object to supply an Accept header for current rules

tls_ja3.description: Caller-asserted JA3 digest; affects rules and cache identity only after server verification

tls_ja4.description: Caller-asserted canonical JA4 value; affects rules and cache identity only after server verification

tls_fingerprint_attestation.description: Short-lived HMAC attestation from a trusted producer; never generate from untrusted request data

extra.description: Arbitrary metadata; current classify rules do not score these values
